caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a simple, rustic design. The chair features four round legs, three horizontal rungs connecting the legs on each side, and a ladder-back with three horizontal slats evenly spaced between two vertical posts extending above the seat. The entire wooden structure of the chair is colored in a greenish-blue hue. The seat is a separate component shown with a dark, textured surface, suggesting it is made from woven material or a different type of finish than the wooden frame. The chair is oriented at an angle where both the front and one side are visible. The drawing is centered on a light, plain background with thin, rectangular borders marked around the image. Scale information and a signature are present at the bottom of the drawing.
title: Ladder Back Chair - Called "Jolting Chair"
